rules: Use same-PDF native path observations and decoded source pixels; never OCR words/confidence to decide cuts.
Eight-connected exact nonwhite/nontransparent components constrain a straight native vertical stroke; all component vertical intervals must intersect its extent.
The transformed recorded stroke band must lie in an interior full-height white/transparent pixel gutter. Cut at the integer gutter center, with no hardcoded column count or physical distance.
All source RGBA pixels must reconstruct exactly from the whole-height crops; no resampling or discarded ink.

Clipped/Form source images, incomplete or oblique geometry and unsupported path evidence retain the full original image. Legacy Page.paths do not certify complete Form clipping, color/compositing or final visibility.

Every source partition uses the documented single-column PSM4; unchanged full-image inputs keep PSM3. One request per selected input/profile, no automatic retry or score-based setting/model selection.
Keep raw text/confidence/original boxes/hierarchy/order and qualified document/page/draw/partition/node references; projection and concatenated partition text are separate derived artifacts.
